idea.title: EcoCharge: Solar-Powered Smartphone Case
idea.description: A rugged smartphone case with integrated high-efficiency solar cells and a secondary battery to extend phone life by 50% in outdoor conditions.
idea.target_user: Outdoor enthusiasts, hikers, and off-grid travelers
idea.context: Seeking sustainable power solutions for remote exploration

cards.title: Market Demand
cards.summary: Strong interest from hiking communities and sustainable tech early adopters.
details: Surveys indicate 70% of frequent hikers would pay a premium for integrated solar charging.

cards.title: Market Sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM)
cards.summary: Targeting a $4.2B global outdoor accessory market with a $280M niche.

cards.title: Competitive Landscape
cards.summary: Existing power banks are cheap and reliable.
details: Big players like Anker already dominate the portable power market with high-capacity alternatives.

cards.title: Technical Viability
cards.summary: Form factor is a challenge for high-efficiency charging.
details: Current solar tech requires roughly 4 hours of direct sunlight for a 20% charge.

cards.title: Strategic Roadmap
cards.summary: Prototype the solar hinge and launch a Kickstarter campaign.
details: Initiate early-bird list for outdoor influencers.
